Role: Financial Planning – FP&A (Analyst)

Experience: 2-3 Years

Location: Pune

Role Overview

We are looking for a motivated and detail-oriented FP&A Analyst to join our UK Finance team based in Pune. This is an exciting opportunity to work across the FP&A function, supporting financial planning, reporting, performance analysis, and business improvement activities.

The role will provide analytical and reporting support to the wider Finance team, helping to improve the quality of management information, strengthen data integrity, and enhance reporting processes. The successful candidate will play an important role in supporting business-as-usual operations, continuous improvement initiatives, and the ongoing adoption of Workday, enabling Finance Business Partners to focus on delivering high-value support to stakeholders across the business.

Key Responsibilities

• Collaborate with Finance Business Partners and FP&A Managers to deliver insightful financial and operational analysis that supports business decision-making.

• Support the production and continuous improvement of monthly reporting packs, KPI reporting, and recurring management information for senior stakeholders.

• Assist with data quality, data-cleansing, and reconciliation activities across financial and people-related datasets, improving the accuracy, consistency, and reliability of reporting.

• Support workforce and FTE reporting, including the preparation of reporting packs and analysis to support business planning and performance management.

• Maintain and enhance reporting models, datasets, and Power BI dashboards, ensuring information is accurate, accessible, and actionable.

• Assist with billing, payroll, timesheet, and other data reconciliation activities to support financial control and reporting accuracy.

• Deliver clear variance analysis and insightful commentary, translating complex data into meaningful business insights.

• Contribute to forecasting, budgeting, and ad hoc financial analysis across the FP&A team.

• Identify opportunities for automation, standardisation, and process improvement to increase efficiency and reduce manual effort.

• Provide flexible analytical and reporting support across the wider FP&A function, helping Finance Business Partners focus on stakeholder engagement and business support activities.

• Support Workday-related reporting, data, and process improvement activities as part of the Finance transformation programme.

What We’re Looking For

• Degree educated in Finance, Accounting, Economics, Data Analytics, Business, or a related discipline.

• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with a natural curiosity for understanding business performance and identifying trends.

• Excellent attention to detail and commitment to producing high-quality work.

• Experience working with large financial and operational datasets, including data validation, reconciliation, and analysis.

• Strong Excel skills, including the ability to manipulate and analyse complex datasets.

• Experience with Power BI or similar reporting and visualisation tools is highly desirable.

• Familiarity with Workday, Anaplan, or other planning and reporting systems, or a willingness to learn.

• Strong communication skills with the ability to present information clearly and effectively.

• Ability to manage multiple priorities and work effectively in a fast-paced, changing environment.

• Collaborative team player with a proactive approach and a desire to continuously improve processes and reporting.

Ambitious and eager to develop a long-term career within a high-performing Finance

• AI adoption and scaling in SDLC and DevOps

• Good Experience in Capital Market



Preferred Qualifications 




• Three to five years of experience in fintech, banking, trading, payments or wealth management technology.



• Experience leading complex legacy modernization and cloud transformation initiatives.



• Knowledge of event-driven architecture, domain-driven design and cloud-native engineering patterns.



• Experience communicating complex architectural decisions to technical and non-technical stakeholders.



• Relevant cloud, software architecture or engineering certifications.

• Post trade/securities lifecycle

At FIS, we are as committed to growing our employees' careers as our own business. We offer:

Company: XBP Global
Job Location: Pune, Maharashtra, India
Employment Type: Full-time
Experience Required: 3+ years

About the Role

:

Role:

Assistant Manager

Location: Pune

Shift Timing: 4 PM - 1 AM

Certification in accounting or finance, such as CA or CPA.
Minimum 3+ years of experience in accounting, finance, or fixed assets management.
Strong knowledge of accounting principles, including GAAP and fixed asset accounting standards.
Excellent analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills.
Ability to work in a rapid-paced environment, meeting deadlines and delivering high-quality results.
Role requires supporting US based business and hence, flexibility to operate in US friendly time zone.
Proficient in Microsoft Office, particularly Excel, and accounting software. .

About the Role:

As a Financial Planning Analyst, you'll take on more responsibility in the preparation and analysis of financial documents. You'll support a variety of financial processes and projects, focusing on the analysis of financial data to provide insights that support organizational decisions.

Responsibilities:

• Prepare detailed financial reports and summaries.
• Conduct financial analysis with some supervision.
• Support various financial forecasting processes.
• Assist in the creation and update of financial models.
• Organize and maintain comprehensive financial data records.
• Analyze sales trends and provide insights.
• Contribute to the development of financial plans and budgets.
• Collaborate with team members on financial projects.
• Monitor economic progressions and assist in relevant research.
• Ensure accuracy and consistency in financial documentation.
Skills:

• Advanced Data Entry: Proficient in detailed financial data entry.
• Financial Analysis: Capable of conducting financial analyses with oversight.
• Modeling Support: Skillful in maintaining and updating financial models.
• Report Generation: Ability to prepare thorough financial reports.
• Trend Analysis: Skilled at analyzing and summarizing financial trends.
• Budget Assistance: Assisting in budget preparation and documentation.
• Research Support: Contributing to economic and financial research activities.
• Collaboration: Effective in collaborating on team financial projects.
• Requires working knowledge and expanded conceptual knowledge in primary job family and broadens capabilities
• Understands key business drivers and builds knowledge of the company, processes and customers
• Performs a range of assignments and solves moderately complex problems under guidance of established policies and procedures
• Receives a moderate level of guidance and direction
• Impacts quality of own work and the work of others on the team may provide informal guidance to new team members
• Explains complex information to others in straightforward situations
Our Interview Practices

We are seeking a highly analytical and intellectually curious professional to support strategic decision-making through deep financial, company, industry, and competitive analysis. The role requires the ability to transform complex datasets and market intelligence into actionable insights for senior leadership.

The ideal candidate should demonstrate strong financial acumen, structured problem-solving, excellent presentation skills, and the ability to independently drive research projects with minimal supervision.

Key Responsibilities

Financial Analysis & Business Performance
• Analyze financial statements and business performance metrics, including EBITDA, working capital, return ratios, efficiency ratios, margins, and valuations.
• Build revenue-to-margin bridges and identify key drivers impacting profitability.
• Reconcile financial variances and prepare management-level analytical reports.
• Develop financial models and scenario analyses to support business decisions.

Company & Industry Research
• Conduct in-depth research on companies, industries, and market ecosystems.
• Evaluate business models, competitive positioning, technological capabilities, regulatory environments, and growth opportunities.
• Assess industry attractiveness, market structure, pricing power, and profitability implications.
• Analyze operational metrics and connect them to financial performance.

Competitive Intelligence & Benchmarking
• Develop comprehensive competitor benchmarking studies.
• Compare peer companies across financial, operational, commercial, and strategic dimensions.
• Normalize datasets for accounting policies, reporting periods, currency impacts, and business models.
• Present actionable insights for strategic decision-making.

Strategic Analytics & Insights
• Integrate and reconcile large, fragmented datasets from multiple sources.
• Identify trends, opportunities, risks, and business implications through data-driven analysis.
• Support market sizing, market share estimation, demand-supply analysis, and industry structure assessments.
• Provide recommendations backed by robust analytical frameworks.

Presentation & Executive Communication
• Create high-quality executive presentations and strategy decks.
• Develop compelling storylines, key messages, and insightful visualizations.
• Translate complex analysis into clear and concise recommendations for senior management.
• Coach and guide team members on presentation quality and analytical output standards.

Research Quality & Methodology
• Critically evaluate market research sources and methodologies.
• Identify limitations, assumptions, and risks within research findings.
• Ensure analytical conclusions are appropriately supported by data and evidence.
• Establish sound research frameworks for strategic projects.

Dashboarding & Reporting (Preferred)
• Design and structure multidimensional dashboards for management decision-making.
• Collaborate with stakeholders to define KPIs and reporting requirements.

Qualification:
• CA with 3-4 years of experience OR
• MBA (Finance) with 8-10 years of relevant experience in corporate strategy, industry research, equity research, investment research, ratings agencies, GCCs, consulting firms, or chemical/agri-business organizations.
